entries.german:
Lehengegenbrief des Lionhart von Rosenberg zu Uttenhoven für Herzog Albrecht über: 4 Höfe u. 2 Sölden zu Oberried bei Uttenhoven in der Seglau bei der Swartzach.
Vorbesitzer: Ritter Jheronimus von Rosenberg
entries.english:
Fief counterletter of Lionhart von Rosenberg of Uttenhoven for Duke Albrecht concerning: 4 farms and 2 smallholdings at Oberried near Uttenhoven in the Seglau near the Schwartzach.
Previous owner: Knight Jheronimus von Rosenberg

facts.content: issued a fief counterletter to Herzog Albrecht for farms and smallholdings at Oberried near Uttenhoven.
had previously held the farms and smallholdings at Oberried near Uttenhoven listed in Leonhard von Rosenberg’s fief counterletter.
